items.stem: Answers degrade midway through a long Claude Code session full of unrelated files. The most direct fix is to:

options.text: Prune irrelevant context so only the relevant files remain in view
options.rationale: Correct: irrelevant context dilutes attention and degrades answers.

options.text: Add even more files so Claude has everything
options.rationale: More irrelevant context worsens the problem.
Input speed is unrelated to context quality.
A machine restart does not address bloated session context.

items.explanation: Correct: irrelevant context dilutes attention and degrades answers.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO help manage a long, costly Claude Code session? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Summarising progress to carry forward only what matters
options.rationale: Correct: a summary preserves state while shedding token load.

options.text: Resetting a bloated session cleanly when it goes stale
options.rationale: Correct: a reset removes accumulated irrelevant context.

options.text: Including every file in the repo just in case
options.rationale: Indiscriminate inclusion raises cost and hurts quality.

options.text: Never summarising so nothing is lost
options.rationale: Hoarding all context is what degrades the session.

items.explanation: Correct: a summary preserves state while shedding token load.

items.stem: A workflow has many mechanical, low-risk steps. A sensible cost trade-off is to:

options.text: Use a smaller, cheaper model for the mechanical steps where quality allows
options.rationale: Correct: matching model to task risk controls cost without hurting outcomes.

options.text: Always use the largest model for every step
options.rationale: Max compute on trivial steps wastes cost.

options.text: Avoid models entirely and do it by hand
options.rationale: That discards the automation's value unnecessarily.

options.text: Run every step twice to be safe
options.rationale: Doubling runs doubles cost without clear benefit.

items.explanation: Correct: matching model to task risk controls cost without hurting outcomes.
